claims.claim: Open Exchange Rates passes the caller's unique App ID as an HTTPS query parameter.
claims.summary: The official introduction documents HTTPS URLs and shows app_id as a GET query parameter.

claims.claim: Time-series requests are currently available only to Enterprise and Unlimited plans.
claims.summary: The official time-series reference states that the endpoint is available to Enterprise and Unlimited clients.

claims.claim: Time-series requests have a maximum query period of one month.
claims.summary: The official time-series reference states that the maximum query period is one month.

claims.claim: Currency conversion requests are currently available only to the Unlimited plan.
claims.summary: The official conversion reference identifies currency conversion as an Unlimited-plan feature.

claims.claim: Validate converted values before using them in a transaction-processing system.
claims.summary: The official conversion reference strongly recommends validating returned values before they are used in transaction-processing systems or interfaces.
